exposure: surgical repair of obstetric vesicovaginal fistula
fistula characteristics (site, size, duration, degree of scarring)
cohort: Seventeen women who underwent surgical repair for obstetric vesicovaginal fistula at Hamlin Fistula Hospital in Ethiopia.
finding: Successful fistula closure was achieved in 65% of patients, but 35% experienced stress incontinence despite closure, at 6 and 12 months follow-up.
mod_finding: All patients in the study had vesicovaginal fistulas associated with complications of labor and delivery, specifically prolonged obstructed labor.
